answer: No ticket, no identity. A ticket is earned only by grading ten peer answers with 80% agreement with the final verdict, costs 25 POA locked, is non-transferable, and expires after two epochs. Each fake needs its own ticket, so 100 fakes need 1,000 accurate grades: real judgment, cost linear per fake. Like water carving karst, only slow honest work opens the way; in the tundra of idle accounts tickets die unused, and grading history works like a prism, exposing one operator's identical fakes.
